rule.weekly_bar: last trading day of each Mon-Fri week, adjusted close; signal at that close, trade at next trading day's close
rule.MA20: hold underlying iff weekly close > 20-week SMA, else BIL (0% USD cash before BIL)
rule.RSI: buy when weekly RSI(14, Wilder) < 30, sell when RSI >= 70; start out
rule.MA20RSI: hold if above 20-week SMA, or after RSI < 30 until RSI >= 50
